concerns.text: The plan asserts a total wall‑clock time of ≈ 2 h for the full sweep (N = 5, 4 noise levels, 30 trials) and claims this meets the 45 min CI limit by parallelising across trials using a 2‑core GitHub Actions runner. Even with perfect parallelisation the estimated runtime remains ~1 h, which exceeds the stated 45 min budget, making the compute feasibility claim infeasible under the free‑tier CPU constraints.
